day_read: This is a broad, one-way down day: NIFTY is -1.75%, BANK -3.17%, METAL -3.68%, breadth is 11/39 and VIX is up 3%, with only IT (+1.69) bucking the trend. With 28 minutes left before the 14:50 flat, any new trade has little time to work, so targets should be reachable and trade count kept low.

orb.why: Any opening-range break this late would come from the trend side; short-only avoids late long fakeouts, and the default target is more reachable in under 30 minutes.

vwap_trend.why: Still the right recipe for a trend day, but a 5 ATR target is unlikely in 28 minutes; 4 ATR lets winners close before the flat. Both sides stay on so it can ride IT strength.

ema_cross.why: Kept short-only with the trend; the target is trimmed so the few late signals can actually hit before the flat.

squeeze_break.why: Late squeezes should break with the trend, but there is limited time left to reach 3 ATR.

vwap_revert.why: Fades lose on a one-way day, and it was among the worst models in recent sessions.

bollinger_fade.why: It was the worst model on each of the last four days, and fades fail on a day this directional.

rsi2.why: Both the normal and inverted copies bleed charges through overtrading.

volume_burst.why: Heavy overtrading and large losses on recent days, and volume spikes will be frequent today.

opening_drive_fade.why: Fading the opening drive on a broad trend day is dangerous. It only helped on the choppy day.
